info.title: Asaltamontes API
info.description: API contract between frontend and backend for data exchange. Identifiers (D-021, T30a): events, conversations, messages and communities are identified by a public UUID v7 (`id`, `conversationId`, `communityId`...); the internal numeric keys never appear in paths, bodies, query parameters or WebSocket payloads. Users go by username and communities also by slug (GET /api/communities/{slug}); join, leave, members and delete of a community take its public UUID. A path or query id that is not a UUID is a 400; an unknown one is a 404. Pagination cursors (`before`, `after`, `nextBefore`, `MessageDto.cursor`) are opaque tokens (T30c): treat them as strings and send back exactly what the server gave; a malformed, tampered or foreign token is a 400 ProblemDetail.

429.description: Too many attempts (rate limiting); see the Retry-After header

400.description: Invalid fields (Bean Validation, errors per field). A username/email already taken or a confirmPassword mismatch answers 409 with the same errors map

get.summary: Get private conversation by username

403.description: T13 (POST /api/conversations/private, same path): neutral 403 when there is a block between both, or when the recipient's dmPolicy does not allow a NEW chat. Sending in an existing chat after a block also gives 403 (WebSocket error queue)

404.description: Conversation not found

groupImage.description: T17c: only the URL of one of your own uploads (urls.medium); external URLs are rejected (400). Prefer groupMediaId

groupMediaId.description: T17c: id of a GROUP_IMAGE media of the caller (404 if missing or not hers, 400 if wrong purpose)

429.description: Too many attempts (rate limiting); see the Retry-After header

post.description: Revokes every refresh token of the current user (all devices, including this one) and clears the refreshToken cookie. Access tokens already issued keep working until they expire (15 min).
Revokes the session of the refreshToken cookie (that refresh token stops working) and clears the cookie. Always 200, even without a cookie or with an invalid one.

parameters.name: refreshToken
parameters.description: Refresh token stored in cookie

429.description: Too many attempts (rate limiting); see the Retry-After header

get.summary: Get authenticated user information

dmPolicy.description: T13: who can start a NEW private chat with her (existing chats are not affected). Default EVERYONE (D-018)

profilePictureUrl.description: T17c: URL of one of your own uploads (urls.medium), or an empty string to remove the picture; a new external URL gives 400 (the value already stored, e.g. Google's, is accepted unchanged). Prefer avatarMediaId

avatarMediaId.description: T17c: id of an AVATAR media of the caller (404 if missing or not hers, 400 if wrong purpose). The previous picture is deleted

dmPolicy.description: T13: who can start a NEW private chat with her (existing chats are not affected). Default EVERYONE (D-018)

isBlockedByMe.description: T13: the caller has blocked this user

404.description: User not found, or she has blocked the caller (T13: indistinguishable)

post.description: Idempotent. Works in both directions: no private chat can be created or used between both, the follows between them are removed (counters fixed), the blocked user gets 404 for the blocker's profile and does not see her in searches or follower lists, and neither can add the other to a group (403 with a neutral message). Shared groups are not touched: nobody is expelled and the messages stay visible. The other user is never notified.

get.summary: One page of the caller's notifications (T18)
get.description: Newest first (createdAt DESC, id DESC). No text: the client composes the message from type + payload. Event payloads carry title, startsAt (UTC instant) and timeZone (the event's IANA zone, D-019). Types: NEW_FOLLOWER, EVENT_JOINED (waitlisted), EVENT_UPDATED (changed: startsAt | timezone | city | meetingPoint), EVENT_CANCELLED (reason), WAITLIST_PROMOTED, ADDED_TO_GROUP (groupName), COMMUNITY_JOIN_REQUEST / COMMUNITY_JOIN_APPROVED / COMMUNITY_JOIN_REJECTED (communityName; target COMMUNITY with the slug; a rejection carries no actor).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque token: the nextBefore of the previous page. It must name a notification of the caller; anything else: 400 'Cursor no válido'

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (values above 50 are capped)

get.summary: Number of unread notifications (badge)

post.description: Either ids (1 to 50) or all: true. Idempotent for already read ones. If any id does not exist or belongs to someone else the answer is the same 404 'Notificación no encontrada' and none is marked. Rate limited per IP (429).

400.description: Neither or both of ids and all, empty or more than 50 ids

404.description: Notificación no encontrada

get.summary: Which notification types are enabled
get.description: Every type, true unless switched off.

patch.summary: Switch notification types on or off
patch.description: D-020: only the types present change. Values are required booleans (null is a 400, it does not 'clear'). An unknown type is a 400 and nothing changes. A disabled type is not created nor sent.

200.description: All the types after the change

400.description: Unknown type, null value or missing types

get.summary: Get one page of the authenticated user's conversations (cursor)
get.description: Most recent first: by lastMessageAt DESC (chats without messages last), then id DESC. For the next page, call again with before = nextBefore (opaque token). unreadChats counts every chat with unread messages, not only this page (navigation badge).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque token: the nextBefore of the previous page. It must name a chat of the caller; anything else (malformed, tampered, another list's token, someone else's chat): 400

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (values above 50 are capped)

nextBefore.description: Opaque token for the next page

get.summary: Get one page of the conversation history (opaque cursor)
get.description: Returns the `limit` messages before `before` (or the latest ones), oldest first. To load older messages, call again with before = nextBefore. In manual groups, a member who joined later sees only the messages sent since she joined (T12), unless an admin enabled historyVisibleToNew; private chats and chats managed by a community or event show everything. Does not mark the conversation as read (use POST .../read or the chat.read STOMP frame). With `after` instead (T11), returns the `limit` messages newer than that message, oldest first; hasMore then means there are newer ones (call again with after = cursor of the last item) and nextBefore is null.

parameters.name: conversationId
parameters.description: Public id (UUID v7) of the conversation. Not a UUID: 400; unknown or not a participant: 404

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque token: only messages older than the one it names (the nextBefore of the previous page, or the `cursor` of a message). Must name a message of this conversation; anything else: 400

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque token (the `cursor` of a message of this conversation): only newer messages (catching up after a reconnection). Anything else: 400. Cannot be combined with before

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (values above 50 are capped)

nextBefore.description: Opaque token for the previous page

400.description: before and after in the same request

401.description: Not authenticated (missing, invalid or expired access token)

404.description: Unknown conversation, or the user is not a participant (same answer, no probing)

post.summary: Mark the conversation as read (unread count to 0)

404.description: Unknown conversation, or the user is not a participant

get.summary: Group details and a page of its participants (T12)
get.description: Participants: admins first, then by joined_at. `size` default 20, maximum 50 (capped). Only groups: a private chat, an unknown chat and a chat the caller is not in all answer the same 404 `Chat no encontrado`.

200.description: GroupDetailsDto { id, name, imageUrl, imageMediaId, participantCount, myRole (ADMIN|MEMBER), historyVisibleToNew, managed, participants: Spring Page of { username, fullName, profilePictureUrl, role, joinedAt } }

404.description: Unknown, foreign or not a group

patch.summary: Rename the group, change or remove its image, toggle the history for new members (admins only, T12)
patch.description: D-020: an absent field changes nothing; `groupImage: null` / `groupMediaId: null` remove the image; `groupName` is required, so null or blank is a 400. `groupMediaId` (preferred) or `groupImage` (URL of an own upload) must be the caller's GROUP_IMAGE media. `historyVisibleToNew` (boolean, manual groups only): when true, people who join later can read the history sent before; by default (false) they see only what is sent since they join. Every change leaves a SYSTEM message in the chat.

403.description: The caller is not an admin

404.description: Unknown, foreign or not a group

409.description: Este grupo se gestiona automáticamente (historyVisibleToNew in a managed group)

post.description: `usernames` (1 to 50) are normalised and deduplicated; people who are already in are ignored; if any username does not exist nothing is added (404). Respects max-group-size (400). Leaves a MEMBER_ADDED system message. New members see the history from the moment they join (unless historyVisibleToNew).

400.description: No valid usernames, or the group would exceed its maximum size

403.description: Not an admin; or (T13) one of the new members blocked the caller or was blocked by her: nothing is added and the message does not say who. Up to 50 per request is kept: the block check is a single query

404.description: Chat not found, or a username does not exist

delete.description: Not herself (400: use leave). She stops receiving messages, loses the history and gets `{conversationId, reason: "REMOVED"}` on /user/queue/conversations.

404.description: Chat not found, or `Participante no encontrada`

patch.summary: Promote to admin or demote to member (admins only, T12)

404.description: Chat not found, or `Participante no encontrada`

409.description: The group would be left without admin, or it is managed automatically

post.description: If she was the last admin, the member who joined first becomes admin; if she was the last participant the conversation is deleted with its messages. Her sessions get `{conversationId, reason: "LEFT"}` on /user/queue/conversations.

404.description: Unknown, foreign or not a group

post.description: The organizer becomes its first attendee (GOING). With communityId only OWNER/MODERATOR members of that community can create it. visibility COMMUNITY requires communityId. timezone is required: an IANA region id (see CreateEvent.timezone), because the time belongs to the event place (D-019).

400.description: Invalid data (past start, end before start, half coordinates, unknown timezone, COMMUNITY without community…)

404.description: Community not found

get.summary: Scheduled events the user can see, soonest first; upcoming by default (T15a, T15c)
get.description: All filters are optional and combine with AND. Events of a COMMUNITY-visibility community the user does not belong to (or is banned from) never appear, whatever the filters. Cancelled events are not listed. Events without distance or coordinates never match a distance or bounding-box filter.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: ISO-8601 instant; default: now

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: ISO-8601 instant; must not be before from

parameters.name: communityId
parameters.description: Public id (UUID) of the community

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Case-insensitive exact match

parameters.name: minDistance
parameters.description: km

parameters.name: maxDistance
parameters.description: km; not below minDistance

parameters.name: minLat
parameters.description: Bounding box: the four of minLat, maxLat, minLng, maxLng or none

parameters.name: organizer
parameters.description: Only 'me': events she organizes

parameters.name: attending
parameters.description: Only 'me': events where she is GOING or on the WAITLIST

200.description: Spring Page of EventSummary (includes latitude and longitude of the meeting point, null when the event has none)

400.description: Invalid filter (unknown enum value, to before from, maxDistance below minDistance, incomplete or inverted bounding box, organizer/attending other than 'me')

get.summary: Search communities (T19)
get.description: Filters combine with AND. city and province are case-insensitive exact matches. Items: id, name, slug, imageUrl, role (null unless an unbanned member), memberCount (ACTIVE+MUTED only), visibility PUBLIC|PRIVATE, city, province.

patch.description: ref is the slug or the public id. Absent field = unchanged; explicit null clears an optional one (description, city, province, image). name cannot be null or blank. Owner and moderators edit everything except visibility, which only the owner changes. The slug does not change on rename. Fields: name, description, city, province, visibility (PUBLIC|PRIVATE), coverMediaId / imageUrl (as in POST). Returns the community detail (id, name, slug, description, imageUrl, role, memberCount, visibility, city, province, joinRequested).

403.description: A moderator tried to change the visibility

404.description: Not found, or not owner/moderator

post.summary: Join a community, or ask to join a private one (T19)
post.description: PUBLIC: becomes a member (201). PRIVATE: creates a pending request (202, idempotent) that the staff accept or reject; the staff are notified. A banned user gets 403 with a neutral message in both cases, and never sees she is banned in role/joinRequested. Leaving (POST .../leave) also withdraws a pending request.

403.description: No puedes unirte a esta comunidad

404.description: Community not found

put.summary: Make a member moderator or plain member (T19)
put.description: Owner only (a moderator gets 403, others 404). Body {role: MODERATOR|MEMBER}. 409 on the owner or an expelled member.

404.description: Community not found, or the caller is not owner/moderator (same answer, uniform)

409.description: Target is the owner or expelled

post.description: Optional body {reason} (max 300). Muted members stay in the list and in the count; only the staff see status. A moderator cannot act on another moderator (403); nobody on the owner (409) or herself (400).

404.description: Community not found, or the caller is not owner/moderator (same answer, uniform)
Community not found, or the caller is not owner/moderator (same answer, uniform)

post.description: Optional body {reason} (max 300). The member leaves the list and memberCount decreases in the same transaction; she loses any moderator role; it is logged. Idempotent. The owner cannot be expelled (409); a moderator cannot expel another moderator (403).

404.description: Community not found, or the caller is not owner/moderator (same answer, uniform)

post.description: Owner or moderators. She becomes ACTIVE, memberCount increases in the same transaction, it is logged. 404 if she is not expelled.

404.description: Community not found, or the caller is not owner/moderator (same answer, uniform)

post.description: Owner only. The target (a non-expelled member) becomes OWNER and the caller a MODERATOR.

404.description: Community not found, or the caller is not owner/moderator (same answer, uniform)

get.summary: Expulsadas (T19)
get.description: Owner and moderators only. Newest first. Items: id, username, fullName, profilePictureUrl, bannedAt, reason, bannedBy (from the moderation log). Returns {items, nextBefore}.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor: the nextBefore of the previous page (400 if malformed or from another list)

404.description: Community not found, or the caller is not owner/moderator (same answer, uniform)

get.summary: Pending requests to join a private community (T19)
get.description: Owner and moderators only. Newest first. Items: id, username, fullName, profilePictureUrl, requestedAt. Returns {items, nextBefore}.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor: the nextBefore of the previous page (400 if malformed or from another list)

404.description: Community not found, or the caller is not owner/moderator (same answer, uniform)

post.description: She becomes a member, memberCount increases, it is logged and she is notified (COMMUNITY_JOIN_APPROVED). 404 if there is no pending request (also if someone decided first).

404.description: No such request, or not owner/moderator

post.description: Logged; she is notified (COMMUNITY_JOIN_REJECTED, without the moderator) and may ask again.

404.description: No such request, or not owner/moderator

get.summary: Moderation log (T19)
get.description: Owner and moderators only. Newest first. Items: id, action (PROMOTE, DEMOTE, MUTE, UNMUTE, BAN, UNBAN, TRANSFER_OWNERSHIP, REQUEST_APPROVED, REQUEST_REJECTED, COMMUNITY_UPDATED), actorUsername, targetUsername (null if the account was deleted), reason, createdAt. Returns {items, nextBefore}.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque cursor: the nextBefore of the previous page (400 if malformed or from another list)

404.description: Community not found, or the caller is not owner/moderator (same answer, uniform)

get.summary: Events of a community the user can see, soonest first; upcoming by default (T15c)
get.description: Same visibility rules and filters as GET /api/events (from, to, type, level, city, minDistance, maxDistance, attending), without communityId or bounding box.

200.description: Spring Page of EventSummary (includes latitude and longitude of the meeting point, null when the event has none)

404.description: Community not found

get.summary: Event detail with myStatus (GOING, WAITLIST, CANCELLED or null) and canEdit

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Public id (UUID v7) of the event. Not a UUID: 400; unknown or not visible: 404

404.description: Not found, or a COMMUNITY event and the user is not an (unbanned) member

patch.summary: Edit an event (D-020): absent field = unchanged, explicit null = clears an optional field; visibility and community cannot change
patch.description: Optional fields that null clears: description, endsAt, meetingPointName, latitude + longitude (both or none), city, distanceKm, elevationGainM, level, capacity (null = no limit; the waitlist moves up). Required fields (title, type, startsAt, timezone) with null give 400. Body: UpdateEvent. Concurrency (@Version) unchanged: a concurrent edit gives 409.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Public id (UUID v7) of the event. Not a UUID: 400; unknown or not visible: 404

403.description: Not the organizer nor community staff

409.description: Cancelled event, capacity below attendeeCount, or edited by someone else at the same time

post.summary: Cancel an event (idempotent). Optional body { "reason": string ≤ 500 }

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Public id (UUID v7) of the event. Not a UUID: 400; unknown or not visible: 404

403.description: Not the organizer nor community staff

post.summary: Join an event (T15b): GOING if there is a place, otherwise WAITLIST at the end. Idempotent

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Public id (UUID v7) of the event. Not a UUID: 400; unknown or not visible: 404

200.description: The event, with myStatus GOING or WAITLIST

404.description: Not found or not visible

post.summary: Leave an event or its waitlist; the first on the waitlist takes the free place. Idempotent

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Public id (UUID v7) of the event. Not a UUID: 400; unknown or not visible: 404

409.description: The organizer cannot leave her own event

get.summary: Attendees by status: GOING (default) in order of arrival, WAITLIST by position

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Public id (UUID v7) of the event. Not a UUID: 400; unknown or not visible: 404

200.description: Spring Page of { username, fullName, profilePictureUrl, status, waitlistPosition, joinedAt }

get.summary: WebSocket STOMP handshake endpoint
get.description: STOMP over WebSocket endpoint used for realtime messages. The client connects to this URL and then sends a STOMP CONNECT frame with an Authorization header 'Bearer <accessToken>'. Without a valid access token the server answers an ERROR frame (header 'message': 'Token no proporcionado' / 'Token inválido') and closes the connection. Only /user/queue/** can be subscribed to. Messages are routed by user id, so they keep arriving after a username change.

401.description: Invalid or missing token during STOMP CONNECT (sent as a STOMP ERROR frame)

content.description: Trimmed; empty or longer than 2000 characters is rejected on /user/queue/errors

subscribe.description: A chat has to leave the list (T12): { conversationId, reason: REMOVED (expelled) | LEFT (she left, other sessions) }
A new notification for the user (T18): same payload as one item of GET /api/notifications. On reconnect, ask again for the counter and the first page (what arrived in between is not replayed).
Errors of the frames this session sent (e.g. writing to a conversation the user does not belong to). Only the sending session receives them.

detail.example: No tienes permiso para escribir en este chat

post.summary: Upload an image (T17a). Re-encoded as JPEG without EXIF/GPS in three sizes (longest side 128, 640, 1280 px; never enlarged). T17c: to use it, send its id as avatarMediaId (PATCH /api/users/me), coverMediaId (POST /api/communities, request field imageUrl still accepted with urls.medium) or groupMediaId (POST /api/conversations/group); the media must belong to the caller and have the matching purpose (AVATAR, COMMUNITY_COVER, GROUP_IMAGE), otherwise 404 (not hers or missing) or 400 (wrong purpose). Responses keep returning the URL of the medium variant in profilePictureUrl / imageUrl / groupImage. Images not linked to anything are deleted after 24 h; each user may store up to 50 MB

file.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP (checked by content), up to 10 MB, 64 to 8000 px per side

400.description: Not a valid image, too small or too big in pixels, unknown purpose or missing file

409.description: T17c: the user reached her image storage quota (default 50 MB)

429.description: More than 30 uploads in an hour (Retry-After in seconds), or the server is busy processing other images

timezone.description: Required. IANA region id from ZoneId.getAvailableZoneIds() (Europe/Madrid, America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires) or UTC. Rejected with 400: fixed offsets (+02:00, UTC+2, GMT+2, Etc/GMT-2) and legacy abbreviations (CET, EST, GMT...). No default: the client sends the browser zone unless the user picks another.

communityId.description: Public id of the community (the id of GET /api/communities)

UpdateEvent.description: PATCH body (D-020). Every property is optional: absent = unchanged; explicit null clears it if the field is optional (400 if it is title, type, startsAt or timezone). Same constraints as CreateEvent; visibility and communityId are ignored.

EventDetails.description: CreateEvent fields plus: id (public UUID v7; the internal numeric id is never exposed, D-021), communityId (public UUID), status (SCHEDULED, CANCELLED, FINISHED), attendeeCount, communitySlug, communityName, organizerUsername, organizerFullName, organizerPictureUrl, imageUrl, cancelReason, cancelledAt, myStatus, canEdit

actor.description: Who did it; null for system notifications (WAITLIST_PROMOTED)

target.description: Where to go: EVENT and CONVERSATION carry the public UUID, COMMUNITY the slug, USER the username

nextBefore.description: Opaque token for the next page

content.example: Nos vemos a las 7 en el parque

systemPayload.description: SYSTEM messages (T12): { action: MEMBER_ADDED | MEMBER_REMOVED | MEMBER_LEFT | ROLE_CHANGED | ADMIN_ASSIGNED | GROUP_RENAMED | GROUP_IMAGE_CHANGED | HISTORY_VISIBILITY_CHANGED, actor?, targets?: [username], name?, role?, removed?, visible? }. Clients compose the text from it; `content` is a Spanish fallback.

cursor.description: Opaque token of this message, to use as `before` / `after` in the history
